digest.component_or_area: CI policy and test guidance documentation
propositions: Intermittently failing tests should be debugged to root cause via /rebar-debug workflow rather than retried until they pass
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md currently contain contradictory guidance that permits rechecking on transient-looking failures without distinguishing environmental faults from test nondeterminism
Flaky CI pipelines slow development, waste tokens, and erode trust in CI as a regression oracle, making root-causing cheaper than repeated rechecks
The recheck comment must be narrowed to state reasoning for provably environmental faults (TLS cert flakes, runner outages, missing CI dispatch) and exclude nondeterministic test failures
Documentation must be reconciled to split environmental faults (recheckable with stated reason) from test bugs (debugged via /rebar-debug) and cross-link rather than duplicate the rule
